articles.title: Modern Architecture in Bahia: Climate and Culture
articles.summary: The article marks the 100th birth anniversary of Brazilian architect Assis Reis. It highlights his work in Salvador, Bahia, where climate and culture influenced his designs. The piece reflects on his legacy in modern architecture.

articles.title: Vaastavya Residence: Vertical Living in Dense Urban Plot
articles.summary: The Vaastavya Residence reimagines a compact urban plot for a three‑generation family. It creates vertical living spaces that balance privacy and creative shared areas. The design replaces an aging home while optimizing limited space.

articles.title: Photography Studio Transformed into Civic Space
articles.summary: After severe flood damage, a Japanese photo studio was rebuilt as a multi‑function civic hub. The new space integrates a café, observatory, and retail, serving the local community. The project redefines the studio as public infrastructure.

articles.title: Thin Plane House on Ibiza Hillside
articles.summary: The project uses a 15 cm‑thick plane that folds with the terrain to create a house on an Ibiza slope. It meets strict regulations while achieving a minimalist aesthetic. The design showcases innovative spatial adaptation to natural topography.

articles.title: Wood atop Brick in Corner Building
articles.summary: The two‑story corner building juxtaposes a wood structure on the upper floor with a brick base. Each facade and floor uses a distinct structural system and material. This contrast highlights diverse construction techniques within a single volume.

articles.title: Curicó House Overlooks Valley with Shaped Roof
articles.summary: The Curicó House sits over the valley, its roof defining interior spaces. Designed by Armstrong Arquitectos and PAR Arquitectos, it integrates the landscape into its form. The roof’s shape creates a dynamic spatial experience.

articles.title: Piódão Plaza Serves as Village Entrance
articles.summary: The village of Piódão, built from schist on a steep slope, features narrow streets and a central plaza. The Largo Cónego Manuel Fernandes Nogueira plaza provides the only flat, unobstructed access. A tourist office occupies this key open space.

articles.title: Cottage  / Archicraft
articles.summary: The site already had a cottage on it, but the existing structure was beyond saving and had to come down. Local regulations set the terms for what could replace it: the new building had to sit on the same footprint as the original, keep to one above-ground floor plus a residential attic, and any sheds or verandas added on top of that could not exceed 10 percent of the existing built-up area, and none of it was allowed to face the forest side of the property. Rather than treat those rules as a constraint to work around, we used them to set the whole massing of the house, a simple gabled form clo

articles.title: Grey House / Adam Kane Architects
articles.summary: The Grey House is a testament to the power of simplicity and harmony. Grey, symbolizing neutrality and introspection, dominates every surface, creating a sense of calm and clarity. The mottled grey surfaces are complemented with monolithic stainless steel elements softened with a cloudy finish, adding a touch of modern sophistication.

articles.title: An Italian Folding Bicycle Design that Fits Into a Suitcase
articles.summary: This T&C Pocket Bici is a folding bicycle made by Tresoldi & Casiraghi, an Italian metalworking firm, in 1963. Unlike the folding bicycles of today that split in half, the components here all fold into the racetrack-shaped frame. The whole thing then fits within its own suitcase. (Brompton bike in the photo for scale.) The bike's origin story is a bit murky; one auction site claims it was created specifically for the Chinese market, and that 2,500 units were sold. articles.title: La Bagnole: A Funky French Utility EV
articles.summary: This La Bagnole is an adorable electric runabout by French EV brand Kilow . Designed by transportation designer Léo Choisel, La Bagnole is part buggy, part pickup truck, designed for both recreation and utility. The vehicle is lightweight, tipping the scales at just 357 kg (787 lbs). It can carry up to 150 kg (331 lbs). It's technically not a car, and is classified as a quadricycle under French law. articles.title: Electric Screwdriver Automatically Identifies Required Bit
articles.summary: A new electric screwdriver uses sensors to detect fastener type and size, then selects the correct bit automatically. This eliminates manual bit selection and trial-and-error fitting. The tool aims to speed up assembly and repair tasks.

articles.title: Turtle Beach Controller Swaps Thumbsticks for Touchpads
articles.summary: The Stealth Flip controller replaces traditional thumbsticks with touchpads for improved PC gaming from a couch. It aims to handle both gameplay and menu navigation without a mouse. The design targets living-room PC gamers.

articles.title: Tiny Forest Sauna Requires No Major Excavation
articles.summary: A compact sauna designed for forest settings sits above ground, avoiding extensive site work. It provides heat and a resting area while minimizing environmental impact. The project emphasizes ease of installation in natural surroundings.

articles.title: Nokia 2360 Flip Phone Offers Remote Setup on 2G
articles.summary: HMD Global releases a basic 2G flip phone with remote configuration features for simple calling needs. It targets users who prefer minimal functionality over smartphones. The device lacks modern connectivity but simplifies setup.

articles.title: Leather Handbag Includes Built-In Light for Easy Access
articles.summary: A leather handbag integrates an interior light to help users locate keys and AirPods quickly. The design addresses the common problem of dark bag interiors. It combines fashion with practical illumination.

articles.title: LEGO Monet Artwork Reveals Detail Without Glasses
articles.summary: A LEGO recreation of Monet's "Path Through the Corn" appears more impressionistic when viewed without corrective lenses. The piece plays with visual perception and pixelation. It highlights the artistic effect of blurred vision.

articles.title: Single-Level Tiny Home Keeps Living Space Downstairs
articles.summary: Dragon Tiny Homes' Avalon 32-foot model places the bedroom on the main floor with standing headroom. The layout avoids lofts, making it more accessible for everyday living. It features a full kitchen and bathroom.

articles.title: AENARA Unveils Mars Habitat Wall Section Exhibit
articles.summary: The Off-World Habitat Wall Section displays layered construction for a proposed Mars dwelling. It shows a rust-red shell, insulated lining, and exposed utilities. The exhibit explores architectural strategies for off-world living.

articles.title: Xiaomi Open Earbuds Feature Five Drivers, Jewelry Aesthetic
articles.summary: Xiaomi's new open-ear earbuds use five drivers per side and resemble tech jewelry. They aim to combine high-quality audio with a fashionable appearance. The design targets users wanting both style and performance.

articles.title: Samsung's Secret Luxury Foldable Line Reveals Gorgeous New Model
articles.summary: Samsung has produced a luxury foldable phone line exclusively in China since 2008. The latest model showcases premium materials and refined design. The line remains largely unknown outside the Chinese market.

articles.title: Sony Launches Glass-Free 3D Desktop Display for Anime
articles.summary: Sony's ELF-MN1 is a compact 3D LCD that shows digital figures and anime avatars without glasses. It targets collectors and fans of virtual content. The screen uses lenticular technology for autostereoscopic viewing.

articles.title: Disposable Camera Made from Mycelium Replaces Plastic
articles.summary: A new disposable camera uses mycelium-based material instead of single-use plastic. It biodegrades after use, addressing waste from traditional film cameras. The design mimics the classic Fujifilm QuickSnap form factor.

articles.title: Nike ACG x Helinox’s 1.2-Pound Chair Refuses to Blend In
articles.summary: Nike ACG and Helinox have collaborated on an ultra-lightweight camp chair weighing just 1.2 pounds. Designed for outdoor enthusiasts, the chair prioritizes portability and compact storage without sacrificing comfort.

articles.title: SOOOT Box Prototype Turns Punched Paper Cards Into Audio Controls
articles.summary: The SOOOT Box is a prototype audio controller that uses punched paper cards to manage podcast playback. It offers a tactile, distraction-free alternative to smartphone interfaces for creators.
